newsitem.title: UK: Slow LIFFE white sugar edges higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Slow LIFFE white sugar edges higher at close.

text.p: London's white sugar futures finished firmer on Thursday but market activity was thin, traders said.
August ended $0.50 firmer at $323.50 per tonne, while October was up $0.70 at $318.20.
Trading ranges were a maximum $1.50 and volume only amounted to 896 lots.
The Paris market was similarly somnolent. August was down $0.20 at $323.10 and October was up $0.30 at $318.00.
The market's focus was on New York's raws market as the spot July contract approached expiry on June 30.
